reason: 560 rupees is less than one boost on a Facebook post, and 6 months fixes my worry that unused credits would expire. I'd try the 10 free test SMS, then buy one pack to push my 12.12 sale to people who miss my weekend lives.
objection: I mostly sell through Facebook live and I decide sales last minute, so I'm not sure my customers will react to an SMS, and I don't want to wait on sender name approval when I'm planning only a day ahead.
would_change_my_mind: If the sender name approval took longer than a day, or the test SMS arrived late or the Sinhala looked broken, I would not pay.
